External PDFs used to check TABifier against common sources.
Public-domain / CC / self-made fixtures only.

tank/Tank p1.jpg, Tank p2.jpg, Tank p3.jpg
  Screenshots of an engraved 4-string TAB (rhythm stems under the staff).
  Used to regression-test the raster TAB reader: faint 0s, TAB clef,
  dotted rhythm, 4-string-on-guitar mapping.

musescore_engraved_tab.pdf
  MuseScore 4 export of our own guitar_riff TAB (vector staff + text frets).
  Same family as a musescore.com / Songsterr-style TAB PDF.

musescore_riff.svg
  MuseScore 4 SVG export of the same guitar_riff TAB (paths + polylines).
  Confirms SVG is accepted as a page image.

ug_style_ascii_tab.pdf
  Ultimate Guitar-style ASCII TAB, printed to a text-layer PDF (fpdf).
  Stands in for "Print to PDF" from a browser tab page.

ug_style_chord_chart.pdf
  Ultimate Guitar-style chords-over-lyrics chart, same print-to-PDF route.
  Contains an embedded riff, like a lot of real song pages.

  Mutopia / LilyPond, CC BY-SA 4.0
  https://www.mutopiaproject.org/ftp/AguadoD/O3/aguado-op03n01/

mutopia_aguado_aminor.pdf
  D. Aguado, A-minor study. Mutopia / LilyPond, CC BY-SA.

imslp_molitor_p21.pdf
  Franz Simon Molitor, Guitar Sonata Op.7, scan page 21 (printed p.18)
  Public domain (1806). Full scan is on Wikimedia Commons.
